_comment: Public configuration for the /build problem solver. Deliberately NOT in site.json: that file is a Sveltia CMS collection, and the CMS rewrites the whole file from the fields it knows about, so a key it has never heard of gets silently dropped the next time anyone edits site settings.
_conversation: The turn-by-turn AI conversation is not on the page right now -- /build is a plain form. worker/intake.js still serves it at /api/intake and is still tested. If it comes back, its settings (opener, turn caps, Turnstile site key) come back with it.
heading: No problem is too small to fix.
summary: Tell us what keeps going wrong and what you already use to handle it. A person reads every one of these, and you get a copy of what we captured.
